annotation.authors_or_issuer: Sejm of the Republic of Poland
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Road Traffic Law and certain other acts.
Touches motor/traffic insurance, with the Insurance Guarantee Fund and Polish Motor Insurers' Bureau as keywords.
Art. 1 pts 7-9 take effect 5 July 2026; arts. 2, 4, 5 take effect 24 December 2025 with effect from 1 January 2026.
References Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 on vehicle type-approval and general safety.
annotation.summary_en: Polish Act of 21 November 2025 amending the Road Traffic Law and other acts, published in Dz.U. 2025 item 1843. Metadata indicates changes touching road transport and motor insurance; it references EU Regulation 2019/2144. Only metadata is available, with no AI or robotics content evident.
